Hi Sofia,

As part of our SIG intake and SOC 2 collection, security asked for a small sample set to validate your SCIM delta behavior and SAML assertion contents for role mapping. Specifically we need: 1) a redacted SCIM snapshot (<= 1000 rows) showing role assignments and service-account labels, 2) 3 sample SAML assertions for human user logins (with NameID and role-related attributes) and 3) a short description of your redaction approach for PII in exported artifacts.

Target timeline: we need to hand this to our audit team by EOD Tuesday (2027-07-27). Can you confirm you can deliver a redacted bundle + a one-page runbook explaining what fields were redacted and why? If there are known sensitive service accounts or ephemeral admin tokens, flag them in a separate file (we'll treat that as confidential).

Thanks — Ben

Subject: Re: Data Access Audit: SAML/SCIM Snapshot Transfer & Redaction Sprint

Quick internal note — I ran a dry export from our staging tenant (export window 2027-07-20). Observations and proposed redaction:

- SCIM snapshot (sample): scim-snapshot-20270720.csv (attached) — contains columns: user_id, username, email, external_id, groups, roles, service_account_tag, last_activity_ts.
- Redaction policy: replace email with hashed token (sha256(email) truncated to 12 chars), replace username with synthetic id (user-XXXX), drop external_id entirely for samples, keep roles/groups intact. Mark service_account_tag values but redact actual service keys.
- SAML assertions: three captures (human-login-1..3) will include Subject NameID (redacted to "redacted-nameid-#"), and attributes: "roles", "department", "auth_method". We will keep attributes intact so auditors can validate claim mapping.
- Sensitive exceptions: two service accounts show elevated privileges (svc-analytics, svc-ops). My recommendation: include a separate confidential.csv that lists those accounts and a justification column; do not include secrets.

I'll attach the SCIM sample CSV and the draft runbook (redaction-runbook-draft.md). Laura — can you validate that dropping external_id conforms with your minimum-evidence list? Marissa — can you prep the Drive folder with restricted access and request Ben's account specifically?

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Principal Applied ML Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: scim-snapshot-20270720.csv, redaction-runbook-draft.md
